agreed_facts.text: A cargo or container ship sank in or near the Strait of Hormuz on Tuesday.
Iran or Iran's Guards reported that a ship sank after hitting a mine in the Strait of Hormuz.
The ship reported to have hit a mine was carrying around 2,500 containers.
A Singapore-flagged ship was hit by a projectile and sank, according to maritime authorities.

headline_quotes.quote: Two container ships sink near strait of Hormuz amid surge in Iranian attacks
suggests Iran is trying to close waterway before US midterm elections

emphasis.text: Attributes the mine account to Iran's Guards and reports the vessel caught fire before sinking.
Reports two container ships sinking after missile strikes amid a rise in Iranian attacks.
Links the rise in strikes to a possible Iranian aim of closing the waterway before US midterm elections.

headline_quotes.quote: Container ship hit by projectile sinks in Strait of Hormuz, Singapore says
All 21 sailors on the Singapore-flagged GFS Pride were evacuated safely

emphasis.text: Leads with the Singaporean account of a projectile strike and names the ship as GFS Pride.
Foregrounds the safe evacuation of all 21 sailors.

headline_quotes.quote: Moment US helicopters blow up Iranian spy boat in huge blaze

emphasis.text: Leads with US helicopters striking an Iranian spy boat with missiles.
Describes the sunken ship as carrying iPhones and as hitting an Iranian sea mine.

omissions.text: Left coverage does not mention the safe evacuation of the crew.
Right coverage does not mention the safe evacuation of the crew.
Centre coverage does not mention Iran's report that a ship sank after hitting a mine.
Right coverage does not mention reports of a ship being hit by a projectile or missiles.
Left coverage does not mention a US helicopter strike on an Iranian boat.
Centre coverage does not mention a US helicopter strike on an Iranian boat.

contested_claims.claim: The ship sank after hitting a naval mine.
Two container ships sank near the Strait of Hormuz, rather than one.

headline_quotes.quote: Container ship hit by projectile sinks
US helicopters blow up Iranian spy boat

emphasis.text: Includes accounts of projectile or missile strikes alongside the Iranian mine claim.
Places the sinking in the context of Iranian attacks and US military action.

headline_quotes.quote: Iran reports cargo ship sinks after hitting mine
first time Iran has reported a ship sinking after hitting a mine during the war
unclear if two statements refer to same vessel

emphasis.text: Leads with Iran's report of a mine and notes it is the first such sinking Iran has reported during the war.
Sets the Iranian mine account beside the UK agency's projectile account and notes it is unclear if they concern the same ship.
